column1: # ZAP rules of the US-031 scans: zap-baseline.py -c (packaged baseline) and the gate of every report
# (infra/verify/src/zap-report.ts, which also judges the authenticated scans' reports with this file).
# Format: <plugin id> TAB <IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL> TAB (<name>) TAB <reason>. Unlisted rules WARN.
# The gate fails on ANY High alert (an IGNORE here never hides a High), and on any alert of a FAIL rule.
# An IGNORE needs a reason that says why the alert is wrong or irrelevant FOR THIS SYSTEM, and a review;
# never IGNORE a High to make a scan pass (fix it, or record an accepted risk in docs/asvs-l2-checklist.md).
# Informational rules that carry no finding here:

column4: Informational: says the site uses JavaScript and suggests the Ajax spider; not a vulnerability

Informational cache classification of every response, not a finding by itself.
